reply: {"action":"conclude","root_cause":"I could not read the files or run probes, so this is an inference from the rejected fix and is unproven. The check made 101 cash-ins at one position and saw 0 calls to GameAssets.burst, so the milestone burst never ran. The likely cause is that the milestone logic sits somewhere the real cash-in path does not reach. It may be behind an early return or a dedupe or cooldown guard, or in a branch that only runs for the popup. Alternatively, the burst call uses a cached local reference to burst, or is sent only to the client, instead of calling GameAssets.burst on the server at call time. The per-collector cumulative count must be incremented on every successful cash-in, and the milestone check must run right after it.","file":"ServerScriptService/CashInService.luau","evidence":"The verification run of 101 cash-ins at one position recorded burst on 0 calls (expected 1 to 4, for milestones 1, 10, 50 and 100). That means the earlier milestone code was never executed, or never called GameAssets.burst. I did not probe this myself.","fix_hint":"In the function that handles each cube cash-in, before any early return, throttle or dedupe, increment a per-player collected counter (keyed by UserId, with a server-side table reset on PlayerRemoving). If the new count is 1, 10, 50 or 100, call GameAssets.burst(collector, tierColor, 30) through the module table, not a cached local. In the same branch, send the popup with a 1.5x size and the Win sound, and use CashInConfig.pitchForTier for streak pitch. Fire the burst only on those four counts."}
